transcription_method: Read word/document.xml from each supplied DOCX archive without changing the archive.
Extract table cells in document order and flatten merged headers into explicit machine-readable columns.
Preserve every numerical cell used by the reproduction; normalize thousands separators and split paired voltage cells into stage_1/stage_2 fields without changing their numerical values.
Cross-check conductivity and voltage units against the rendered y-axis labels of main Figure 3 and SI Figure S11, because the corresponding table headers omit those units.
Recompute only transparent reductions (MAE, RMSE, mean elapsed hours, and AIMD/MLIP elapsed-time ratio); never infer or synthesize model predictions.
Transcribe the top ten entries and collection-level provenance from already-completed 247-candidate screening artifacts; preserve portable locators, declared units, and implementation versions.
Represent historical transport replay separately from AIMD/DFT validation, and preserve unseen/transfer statements only at claim level when paired numerical evidence is unavailable.

limitations: The source documents are mutable authoring files rather than a published version of record; the recorded paths refer to the supplied revisions.
Underlying predictions, trajectories, model weights, and training structures are not distributed, so the replay validates transcription and reductions rather than recomputing predictions.
The static PES table does not report the underlying test-set sample count; normalized routing treats each published aggregate row as one evidence record and records this limitation explicitly.
The exact top-candidate transport replay validates historical sampling/post-processing parity only; no matched AIMD trajectory or DFT reference for that candidate is included.
The unseen/transfer narrative lacks paired raw energy, force, and conductivity values, so it remains claim-level evidence and cannot support numerical parity.
